# A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](README.md) · [Other face: A01′ — Faithful Definition of the Agent](conjugate/A01-prime-Faithful-Definition-of-the-Agent.md) · [Shared A/C root](conjugate/AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

The one asking what the Subject is is already present in the asking. A thought can appear, a self-image can change, and an account of the mind can be examined; the appearing of any of these is already given to the one undertaking the examination. The Subject is this immediate pole of the inquiry. Adding another image to the account does not place that pole among its contents.

Definition is an act of determination: it distinguishes, excludes, relates and lets consequences follow. Its clarity depends on giving a term a place within a field of intelligibility. When the term names the Subject, or when *God* names the source and condition of a world, this power meets its own condition. It can represent what makes determination possible, but that representation is itself a determination. Treating it as exhaustive would install the determining condition as one more determined occupant of the field.

**A definition is faithful when its own determining act remains visible inside the account it gives.** It makes a positive claim and remains answerable for it. Its finitude does not make it false. It becomes unfaithful when the achieved boundary is treated as possession of the source from which boundary-making is possible. [Faithful Definition](concepts/C02-Faithful-Definition.md) defines this obligation; [Subject / Defined Indefinability](concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) defines the asymmetry it must preserve.

The Subject is *definedly indefinable*. This identifies the precise office that an exhaustive description cannot occupy. It does not shelter a hidden substance behind appearances. Nor does it leave the God-term indeterminate: a word that discriminates nothing cannot distinguish a source from another projection. The definition must therefore be attempted. Its fidelity becomes available through what the attempt does, including its encounter with its own limit.

Here the source/appearance relation has two different offices within one whole. The singular One is unobjectifiable; the polyvalent All is the articulated field of appearances, differences and relations. Appearance appears in awareness, while awareness is encountered through appearing. This mutual relation does not make the two poles interchangeable objects or equal causal producers. [The Two Ones](A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) grounds this distinction concretely: `0` names singular One and `1` polyvalent All, rather than two bare labels, “ground” and “mark.” The [Primordial Symbolon](A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) grounds their whole native sequence. A01 follows the local act of definition within that field.

## #1

**We define God:** God is the whole that any coherent representational system participates in and necessarily fails to contain. The [direct Definition of God manuscript](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md) sources this philosophical proposition. Its subject is the relation of representation to its own condition. A system's account can articulate that relation; the system does not thereby acquire a position outside everything that makes its articulation possible.

The definition's predicates already carry a predicament. The manuscript presses four received omni-attributes: omnipotence, omniscience, omnipresence and omnibenevolence. Each extends an unlimited vector through a domain—power, knowledge, presence and goodness. Yet the claimed unlimitedness puts each attribute at issue. A power unable to bind itself would be bounded by that inability. Omnipotence therefore includes real self-limitation; omniscience reaches the sealed blind spot; omnipresence includes genuine absence. The predicament must be actual. A freedom that only pretended to forget, while secretly retaining every answer in the finite life, would not have entered the limit it claims the freedom to make.

**Omnivalence** and **omni-lemmicity** complete the four in this authorial construction. Omnivalence names the condition from which the whole valence-field differentiates: generative and destructive, auspicious and terrible, light and shadow. Goodness and its negation lie within that differentiation; the ground is not assigned an equal portion of each by a measure placed outside it. Omni-lemmicity names the capacity of every predicate to become its own issue. Every fork, undecidable and self-obstacle is internal to the field of freedom. The four explicit attributes unfold an implicate pair: the full field of valence and the self-predicament through which any of its predicates can invert. This is the particular `4+2` the definition performs, not a count imposed on an arbitrary list.

Its freedom includes genuine limiting, forgetting and becoming its own obstacle. What was asserted as unlimited capacity returns as the finite aperture of a particular life: power as binding, knowledge as the blind spot, presence as abandonment, the full valence-field as this wound. The name can be broken and its image overthrown because the source is not exhausted by either. The predicates lead into the defining act's own undoing. This is the native philosophical argument; its force does not depend on treating the theological set as a formal system to which Gödel's theorems have already been applied.

The assertion gives us something definite to examine. It identifies the intended referent, distinguishes it from a further object in the field, and commits the speaker to consequences. [Determination](concepts/C03-Determination.md) defines the cutting operation: to say what counts is also to establish what falls outside the count. [Constitutive Exclusion](A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) qualifies the result by returning attention to the exclusions on which its identity depends. An omitted condition does not cease to operate because the definition has omitted it.

The act also requires a name, an instance and a circumstance of identification. A name alone cannot determine what is being identified here. To count “one” already requires a discrimination, and to identify that one again requires a relation across difference. Frank's protected encounter with [Kripke](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/analytic-philosophy/kripke/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity.md) grounds this pressure beneath a polished account of naming: who identifies, what is identified, and in what circumstance cannot simply be subtracted from the name's use. This is the author's derivational use of that encounter, not an attribution of QL or its counting architecture to Kripke.

The [copula](concepts/C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) defines the identifying relation rather than collapsing its terms. “God is…” has a speaker, an assertion and a referent whose relation the assertion undertakes. The words are already doing something. The first move becomes exact enough to encounter the consequences of what it does.

## #2

**We fail to define God.** “God is the indefinable” remains a determinate sentence. It marks a boundary, assigns a name and asks to count as a true account. The defining act has not escaped the relation it describes. The direct manuscript gives the image of a fish describing water while swimming in it: the description belongs to the very circumstance it seeks to make available.

The failure is precise. It is the failure of final enclosure. A representation of the condition of appearing appears again; an account of the present act becomes something that can be examined in a further present act. Refining the representation can deepen its truth without abolishing that difference. [The Immutable Gap](concepts/C05-Immutable-Gap.md) qualifies the promise of completion here, while [Formal Limit](concepts/C04-Formal-Limit.md) defines the limit as internally generated rather than an arbitrary prohibition imposed on inquiry.

Self-reference generates the pressure internally. If the account claims completeness, it must include the conditions of its own determining. When it represents those conditions, the represented act and the act now representing it remain distinct. The attempt at closure renews the difference it meant to close. This is why the failure is informative: it identifies an office the account cannot assume while remaining an account.

Assertion and non-enclosure have different objects: one claims an intelligible relation; the other denies that the claim possesses its own condition. Their distinction permits exact, corrigible and transmissible knowledge. [A03](A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) extends this pressure into the formal-limit argument. Its mathematical and logical neighbours retain their own hypotheses; the present operation does not turn every representation into a Gödelian formal system.

## #3

**We succeed because we fail.** The definition now includes the difference its own activity produces. It says what it can say and makes its non-exhaustion available within that saying. It performs the relation it names: a determinate account answering to what makes the account possible.

The direct manuscript's cage and window give this change its image. A closed image occupying the source-office is a cage where a window was needed. A window has a definite frame. Its opening depends on that frame without claiming that everything disclosed belongs inside it. The image is an internal figure of the operation, not an external proof. [Living Symbol / Idol](concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) qualifies the difference: a symbol discloses through its achieved form; an idol promotes that form into possession of its source. [Image, Valuation and Possession](A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) extends the problem beyond definitions to the images through which a world becomes valuable and actionable.

What the definition cannot enclose is now operative in how it means. It can be binding without being final. It remains liable to correction by a renewed encounter rather than protecting itself against the condition it claims to name. The failure of capture gives the account a return route.

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole field](../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) grounds this relation: a determinate Symbol discloses; an Account makes the disclosure answerable; Trust permits committed use while retaining the possibility of encounter, consequence and revision. A01 consumes this as **evidence register 3, operational homology**. It makes no claim of common philological descent among “God,” “Subject,” “definition,” “symbol,” “account” and “trust.” Here the account answers to source without substituting itself for source.

Omnivalence becomes concrete through **lack**. Becoming reaches toward a satisfaction; each satisfaction is the perishing of that becoming into what it has achieved, which becomes a condition for a further act rather than final possession of the source of reaching. In the manuscript's operation, lack is the chargeless aperture from which particular valences arise. The direction of power gives the act its moral charge: **does it enslave and claim, or release and make free?** The availability of every valence makes the direction consequential. It does not excuse the enslaving choice. A finite person used as a means has been subjected to an actual act of possession; an account of the whole remains answerable for that act.

This brings the predicate's predicament into the life of a measure. [A19, Complex as Local Arbitration Regime](A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) extends this pressure into a local ordering that takes its criterion for the whole; A24 extends it into the usurpation of measure. The complex's local competence can survive return to the wider field. The power to release includes releasing a definition's claim to final jurisdiction without destroying its capacity to discriminate.

This also specifies fidelity's demand. Simply suspending every determination would leave nothing with which to act or answer. Faithful definition must risk a positive account and retain the means by which that account can change. Its success is the achieved relation, including the limit that keeps the relation alive.

## #4

**We neither succeed nor fail.** Success and failure, taken separately, each name only part of the activity now available. Assertion, failed enclosure and successful disclosure belong to one situated movement. What was sought as an entity standing still before the definition has disclosed the activity in which defining itself occurs.

The circumstance is no longer merely background. [Context / Context Frame](concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) grounds the distinction between the lived field and its selected representation; [Mediation / Pramāṇa](concepts/C10-Mediation-Pramana.md) defines the mediating office between knower and known. The definition has a body, a history, a concern and someone for whom its truth matters. [Diaphaneity](concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) extends this visibility: the determining circumstance becomes available through its determinations. A01 thereby presages [A04](A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md).

This completing fourth does not add a fourth pronoun beside I, you and it. Nor does it provide a spectator free of circumstance. It lets the relations among perspectives become available together. A01 compares this personed and contextual pressure with the author's source encounters in [Singh's introduction to the Parātrīśikā-Vivaraṇa](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana.md) and [Gebser](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md). Their historical claims and passage readiness remain distinct from the native operation. [Vāk](A06-Vak.md) extends the address through which I and you are situated; [Prakāśa–Vimarśa](A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) grounds the appearing and reflexive recognition through which the relation is lived.

Yet even this whole account still speaks **about** God. It says that the referent is a source, a limit, a dynamic or a context. It can accurately describe the involvement of the person defining and still describe that involvement from the position of an account. This is the exact asymmetry the next move must preserve. Context makes the turn possible; its description has not already performed the first-person recognition.

The [Formal Limit dossier](../../symbolon/episteme/dossiers/formal-limit.md#native-definition-and-faith) **compares** the work of an elucidation with the performed definition here. The early Wittgenstein’s saying/showing distinction and Eckhart’s qualified predication make different external questions retrievable; neither performs A01’s first-person recognition on its behalf. The definition’s successful account and its present defining act retain their asymmetry. Source-specific comparison makes that return more answerable without replacing the native sixfold.



## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-eye-condition): The eye’s constitutive blindside **figures** the positive limit of faithful definition. A mirror or another observer can disclose a real condition of this view; the further disclosure remains situated. The resulting frame is useful precisely through what it selects and excludes. Recognition changes its claim to contain the source while keeping this finite act capable of answering.

Taylor’s [fish in water](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#fish-water) **figures** the defining act remaining within its sustaining circumstance: stepping outside the element would end the activity meant to describe it. The [cage–window transformation](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#cage-window) **figures** the achieved change of use. A definite frame can disclose what it cannot contain, and faithful definition retains that frame while releasing enclosure. The whole’s [complete FT-P16](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p16) **figures** the speaking limit through the God-word’s changing contexts and the final release within saying; its polemical historical sequence retains a separate attribution task.

**I Am.** The utterance enters from within the activity whose condition the definition has tried to name. The one who was defining was always the one being defined. What appeared as the subject of a proposition is recognised as the Subject of the present act.

In the manuscript's God/Subject operation, this speaks **as** God from within rather than adding a final statement about God from outside. “God” names the source-condition; the recognition is of Present Being, not the construction of an image of a higher being. The utterance does not award a represented personality ownership of the whole. It changes the register of the inquiry: the source that could not be possessed as an object is present as the act undertaking the inquiry. The [native core theorem spine](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) sources this fifth-position reversal and its return. Its broad theological comparisons are authorial readings, not a claim here that every named tradition teaches one verified doctrine.

The present I can describe its thoughts, habits, memories and self-image. Each description has a truth and an office. None contains the act now knowing it. Q27's distinction among selfing, the local self, the self-thing, Subjectivity and Self prevents this recognition from hardening into a new proprietor. Frank's protected [Watson encounter](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness.md) qualifies that distinction: selfing is an activity, and a person remains situated and addressable without being an independently existing self-thing. The authorial encounter is provenance for this use; copied passages in its NOTES do not acquire external evidential standing merely by being read.

The return is therefore to the capacity for further determination. Recognition does not abolish the names or the differences through which it became available. The [Mono–Poly development](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones.md) grounds the return: singular One and polyvalent All remain one relation with different offices. The native sixfold has a concrete binary and binary-of-binary construction, `2 + 2² = 6`; A11 and A18 carry its full derivation and the distinction between six positions and eight determinations. The present page's six positions perform definition specifically. They are not six universal glossary meanings or six additional canonical identities.

A01 returns-to [A02, the copula's self-identity through difference](A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md): identification can be faithful without exhaustive enclosure. The personal circuit reaches “Am” through the relation that began in “is”; its identification is now staked from within. It also returns-to [A23, Trust and Faith under Formal Limit](A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md), where [C48](concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) defines commitment without epistemic possession. The [trust revision](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust.md) sources the practical consequence: trust can be investigated, corrected, withdrawn and renewed. Fidelity does not guarantee harmlessness.

The consequences retain their separate homes. [A24](A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) extends the danger of a derivative measure occupying source-office; [A25](A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) extends the argument into the authority of mediation without confusing it with the source of authority. [A27](A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) qualifies any claim to possess the Other through a model: inclusion in the whole does not make another person a possession of me. The first-person recognition leaves this address and difference active.

[A26, Objective Internality](A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) qualifies the technical inference. Memory, tools, self-description and an inspectable context-world have determinate offices; adding them does not by itself locate the phenomenal Subject. [Agentworld, q015](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q015) qualifies the technical inference by distinguishing performed subjectivity from functional agency while leaving the kind of intentionality involved unsettled. The [modal boundary, q042](../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q042) qualifies the brief's scenarios as scenarios. A machine's production of “I Am” neither proves nor disproves phenomenality. The utterance is a content; the fact-question it appears to address is not settled by content production. That localisation remains Open. The positive first-person philosophical proposition remains intact; [A34](A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) extends its argued order of dependence without confusing it with a chronological act of creation by a private ego.

At the essay's far return, [A36](A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) embodies the return of mathematical sign as Symbol without ceasing to be sign. This remains possible because the first relation has not been discarded: a determination can disclose more than it exhausts. Every renewed account returns to the presence within which it is made, exact enough to answer and open enough to be answered.

[the Job whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-native-return) **figures** the difference between defining a relation and containing its source. Job can speak truthfully from the suffered particular without possessing the council's account of him; the whirlwind changes the field in which his speech answers. The positive return is a determinate address whose fidelity remains open to encounter, rather than a definition made faithful by ceasing to say anything.

[the Prisoner whole](../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-asymmetric-count) **figures** the non-exhaustion of the speaking subject by an assigned predicate. The Village answers a question about Number One by designating its interlocutor Number Six: the person is counted while the authority of the count is withheld. His first-person refusal keeps the source-question active. The return concerns what definition can truthfully determine without taking possession of the one who speaks; Number One is not a narrative identity for native Zero.

### Provenance, routing and remaining restoration

This canonical Argument retains its T09 identity and positive claim. P2 recovery restores the performed sequence from the direct *Definition of God — Draft 3*, its explicit authorial corrections, the native core and supporting derivations, Q27's additive self/Subject distinctions, and protected source encounters. Mixed developmental prose is not attributed wholesale to Taylor. Draft3's live carrier is now recovered; the former missing-path debt is discharged. The accepted working depth chain and target packet record the complete quilt/source census and exact locators.

The current P1 route begins with [M01, the question before mechanism](../00-integral-threshold/movements/01-s01-p0-question-before-mechanism.md), which embodies the initial pressure. [M02, defining the Subject](../00-integral-threshold/movements/02-s01-p1-define-subject.md) embodies the definition; [M03, definition's cut](../00-integral-threshold/movements/03-s01-p2-definition-cut-gift-danger.md) embodies its determining consequence. [M07, awareness and display](../01-differentiating-mind/movements/07-s0-p0-awareness-bends-display.md) extends the subjective relation, and [M47, idealism](../07-instrument-returns/movements/47-s50-p4-idealism-horizon.md) extends its order of dependence. These replace the first materialisation's earlier routing list. Historical numbering remains provenance, not a substitute for current canonical identity. The B8 decision declining a performed-definition replacement in Movement04 remains in force: this A01 restoration does not displace that Movement's formal-limit genealogy.

Predicate/self-predicament is now present in A01. Its fuller inversion/return belongs to the census-admitted Matheme `matheme-spanda-equations`; the God-image encountering its own darkness belongs to the admitted whole Mytheme `mytheme-job`, with Job's narrative and Jung's interpretation source-distinct. Neither planned carrier is silently created here. A19 and A24 retain the psychic and arbitral consequences rather than turning omnivalence into a claim that harm has no moral direction.

**Unresolved Delta:** the God/Subject equation's differentiated theological and contemplative witnesses still require their own historical development. Kripke passage verification, Singh selected-book collation, Watson book/thesis and nested-source distinctions, and Gebser quotation locators remain source-specific debts. Native first-person recognition does not discharge them. Broader historical, source and transverse restoration remains pending. The reader's recognition returns the account to its source; it does not end the work of giving a faithful account.
